conditional_findings.first_contract: A value presented as PropertyId should satisfy the same identity contract whether it is constructed directly or decoded, subject to the intended enclosing-catalog contract.
conditional_findings.trace: PropertyId::new accepts only a nonempty bounded StrategicIdentityComponent and nonzero building ID, then creates a length-prefixed property string. PropertyId also derives Deserialize with serde(transparent) on its private String and has no visible custom decoder. The pinned serde_derive source chooses the inner field Deserialize and directly constructs the wrapper; under that derive, a standalone JSON string such as "x" can form a PropertyId although no PropertyId::new output has that form. GeneratedHomeCatalog::parse returns the decoded object without validation.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: This is static source and pinned-macro inference only: no feature resolution, macro expansion, JSON decode or product operation ran. The shown database registration finds the settlement and calls catalog.validate before registration; that validator recomputes every property ID with PropertyId::new, checks duplicates and other constraints. The shown tactical scene validator also validates the catalog before resolving homes. Other consumers and intentionally unvalidated parsing remain open; no accepted malformed persisted property, actual network input or user impact was observed.
connected_repair_dependencies: Determine whether PropertyId itself or its validated enclosing catalog is the intended admission owner and trace all native decoding and retained consumers.

If the standalone type owns its identity guarantee, specify a complete unambiguous decoding policy, maintain the settlement/building scope and reject invalid identities without retaining backward-compatibility shims.
Keep registered-catalog verification, deterministic seed and duplicate/capacity checks connected; reconcile historical aliases before implementation.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; direct decoder mismatch inferred, supported malformed consumer not established

conditional_findings.first_contract: The settlement identity should preserve its intended validation and role from the physical city producer through the generated catalog, seed and registration boundaries.
conditional_findings.trace: The database Settlement primary key and SettlementSceneProfile use String; dispatcher and CitySceneLayout::generated_homes accept &str, derive the deterministic seed from its bytes and retain a String settlement_id in GeneratedHomeCatalog. PropertyId::new validates that same value using the existing generic StrategicIdentityComponent, then discards the typed value. The generated catalog validates its settlement, population, seed, property IDs and capacity; the database registration looks up the settlement row and calls validate before it publishes property records. StrategicPlaceId already carries the generic component for settlement scope but that type also represents other strategic IDs and is not a settlement-specific owner.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: A raw internal value and a generic component are not by themselves proof of confused identity, bad database state or a requirement to create a new type. Decide whether generic reuse, a settlement-specific owner or an explicit boundary is semantically appropriate after tracing all producers, supported ID namespace, serialization, schema and consumers. The original059 L12 pending contract is being reassessed, not promoted to checkpoint3821 or counted as a new historical finding. Earlier personal Lens1 reads of roles136/139/989/992 are not evidence that Segovb personally reread them under Lens12.
connected_repair_dependencies: Trace actual settlement import and existence validation, scene profile creation, deterministic seeds, strategic place references, generated catalogs and native database/wire boundaries.

Choose an owner with explicit scope, validation and permitted namespace rather than a shadow type or raw aliases; preserve canonical byte encoding and deterministic relationship only where required by actual current design.
Reconcile prior inherited Lens12 evidence and all exact aliases; no compatibility shims, implementation or runtime checks at this stage.
